column1: # ZAP baseline scan rules for .github/workflows/zap-baseline.yml (tab-separated: rule id, action, name).
# FAIL fails the scan; WARN is reported only; IGNORE is skipped. The IGNOREs below are headers GitHub Pages
# can't send (the site sets its CSP in a meta tag instead); switch them to FAIL after moving to Cloudflare

column3: Anti-clickjacking header (GitHub Pages can't send X-Frame-Options)
Content Security Policy header not set (the CSP is in a meta tag on GitHub Pages)
Permissions Policy header not set (GitHub Pages can't send it)
Insufficient site isolation against Spectre (COOP and CORP need headers)
Cross-domain misconfiguration (GitHub Pages allows any origin to read public static files)
